EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I can't believe I have so much fun
just going shopping!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hay que ver qué locurón
es ir a comprar!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si j'avais su qu'un jour je
m'éclaterais autant en faisant mon
shopping !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non avrei mai creduto di potermi

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}I knew I'd find what I was looking
for, but it still feels like a victory!

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Sabía que aquí tendrían lo que

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Eigentlich war ja klar, dass ich hier

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Aradığımı bulacağımı biliyordum ama
